text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of what people write. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language into another. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover if customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to chat with people and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, computers can now communicate with us in ways that feel more natural every day.
